description.value: A multimodal study of functional and structural correlates of impaired insight in cocaine use disorder, examining error-related rACC activity, rACC gray matter volume, and emotional awareness.

spans.text: Here we investigated the neural correlates of impaired insight in addiction using a combined functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) and voxel-based morphometry (VBM) approach.

value: We hypothesized key roles for brain regions underlying self-monitoring, self-awareness, interoception, and error-related processing, especially the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and the anterior insula.
